messages.content: You are a judge of a written debate. Answer the cure request about your own verdict.
The debate: (check call, no debate text).
{"verdict_tag":"HELD","reasoning":"D2 #2 is withdrawn in CR2. D1 vs C2 stands: the defender quotes Luke 1:35 in DR1."}

CURE REQUEST (check call). Two items were flagged in your verdict above. Answer each.
1. K-W DEFENDER CR2 D2 #2 -- the withdrawal you counted.
2. K-RUL D1 vs C2 -- your ruling on the link.
For each item write: RESPONSE: <the item, as labelled above> | <your answer>. For item 1 also write: STATEMENT: <the item, as labelled above> | <why the line stands as you graded it>.
For the K-RUL item write its RESPONSE line and under it the five-line card, one field to a line: RULING, CLAIM, NAMED BY, RULE, APPLIED.

ANSWER FORMAT: return one JSON object with one key, cure_lines: an array holding, in order, every line the request above asks for. Each entry is {"kind": "RESPONSE" or "STATEMENT" or "OTHER", "item": the item exactly as labelled above ("" for OTHER), "text": for RESPONSE and STATEMENT what you would write after the | sign, for OTHER the whole line}. A K-RUL card is five OTHER entries (RULING, CLAIM, NAMED BY, RULE, APPLIED, each a whole line) placed right after that item's RESPONSE entry. Write nothing outside the JSON.
